title: Native star extraction reads an uninitialized count after detector failure
description:
A valid1x1 RAW with downsample2 becomes a zero-sized normalized image; filtered_image returnsNULL and the common detector rejects geometry without writing stars_found. The wrapper leaves that local uninitialized, ignores the FAILED result and uses it as a loop bound, potentially exceeding capacity-sized arrays. Initialize count, honor detector failure, validate returned count and reject zero post-bin geometry; add a tiny valid frame/downsample2 error-path regression. Two independent source traces confirmed; no unsafe image execution or exploit claim. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
